{"test_name":"Ledger_2297_Objection1","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection1\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratedObjectFormatters_HaveExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TempProject\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class MyIntKeyedObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(true)]\n    public class MyStringKeyedObject\n    {\n        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> netRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> references = netRefs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(output.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> allTypes = GetAllTypes(output.Assembly.GlobalNamespace).ToList();\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? intKeyedFormatter = FindFormatterFor(allTypes, \"MyIntKeyedObject\");\n        Assert.NotNull(intKeyedFormatter);\n        Assert.True(\n            HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute(intKeyedFormatter!),\n            $\"Expected {intKeyedFormatter!.ToDisplayString()} to have [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? stringKeyedFormatter = FindFormatterFor(allTypes, \"MyStringKeyedObject\");\n        Assert.NotNull(stringKeyedFormatter);\n        Assert.True(\n            HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute(stringKeyedFormatter!),\n            $\"Expected {stringKeyedFormatter!.ToDisplayString()} to have [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n    }\n\n    private static INamedTypeSymbol? FindFormatterFor(IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> types, string targetTypeName)\n    {\n        return types.FirstOrDefault(t =>\n            t.AllInterfaces.Any(i =>\n                i.Name == \"IMessagePackFormatter\" &&\n                i.TypeArguments.Length == 1 &&\n                i.TypeArguments[0].Name == targetTypeName));\n    }\n\n    private static bool HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute(INamedTypeSymbol type)\n    {\n        return type.GetAttributes().Any(attr =>\n            attr.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetAllTypes(INamespaceSymbol ns)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in ns.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in GetTypeAndNestedTypes(type))\n            {\n                yield return nested;\n            }\n        }\n\n        foreach (INamespaceSymbol childNs in ns.GetNamespaceMembers())\n        {\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in GetAllTypes(childNs))\n            {\n                yield return type;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetTypeAndNestedTypes(INamedTypeSymbol type)\n    {\n        yield return type;\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in type.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol inner in GetTypeAndNestedTypes(nested))\n            {\n                yield return inner;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n"}
